TITLE: Status Update on Tegurine Annex Configuration and Contractual Agreement

TO: Internal Planning Subcommittee  
FROM: Liluan Nemlurel  
DATE: April 3, 2025  
SUBJECT: Tegurine Annex Operational Status

Liluan Nemlurel is currently evaluating the Tegurine Annex in preparation for the upcoming internal planning review. This document provides a summary of the venue’s current configuration and the status of its contractual obligations.

The Tegurine Annex has a total seating capacity of 480, as defined in its current layout. This number accounts for all assigned seating and does not include potential standing areas or flexible configurations that may be available under alternate arrangements. Discussions are ongoing between the Solutions Architect and facility management to assess whether adjustments might better support upcoming event requirements. No formal proposals or modifications have been authorized at this time.

The Tegurine Annex’s usage is governed by contract number GS-9629-Z. A copy of this agreement is accessible to authorized personnel through the internal document management system. Any adjustments to the terms of this contract, or to the way the annex is used, must go through the formal approval process and receive legal review prior to implementation.

Liluan Nemlurel is also working with the finance lead to ensure that the annex’s usage remains within the parameters of the current budget and contractual framework. This includes a thorough analysis of the obligations outlined in GS-9629-Z, particularly those related to event limits, cancellation conditions, and any additional agreements. No immediate financial adjustments are currently required, but this review remains an active process.

Zastama Industries continues to ensure that all contracted facilities are aligned with operational needs while maintaining compliance with legal and fiscal constraints. Liluan Nemlurel will follow up with the subcommittee in the coming weeks with a more detailed report and proposed next steps. For any inquiries regarding the Tegurine Annex’s configuration or contractual status, please contact Liluan Nemlurel directly.
